units.source_text: 每次看见阳光在远处的水田里闪耀的时候，我都会疑是肉眼看不见的金阁的投影。

en.t: Whenever I saw the sunlight glittering in the distant rice paddies, I would wonder whether it was the reflection of the Golden Pavilion, invisible to the naked eye.

units.source_text: 成为福井县和京都府分水岭的吉场岭，正好坐落在正东的方向。

en.t: Yoshiba Ridge, which forms the watershed between Fukui Prefecture and Kyoto Prefecture, lay exactly to the east.

units.source_text: 太阳从这山岭附近升起。

en.t: The sun rose from near this mountain ridge.

units.source_text: 它与现实的京都是正相反的方面，然而我透过山谷的晨曦却看见了金阁高耸云天。

en.t: It was in the exact opposite direction from the real Kyoto, and yet through the morning light in the valley I saw the Golden Pavilion towering into the clouds.
